data.text/markdown:
STAR dataset overview

STAR is a large-scale scene-graph-generation dataset for very high resolution satellite imagery. Every image has oriented-bounding-box (OBB) object annotations (STAR-object) and object-level relationships (STAR-relationship), which together form a scene graph:
  • nodes = oriented boxes with a category (ship, dock, bridge, ...)
  • edges = (subject, relationship, object) triplets, e.g. ship – parallelly docked at – dock
